analysis.reason: RSI 38.5 → 52.9 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 안착 확인. MACD 히스토그램 -1.1709 → 0.2136 개선으로 약세 전환 신호. 5일 저가 $68.72 대비 5일 고가 $90.62 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴 완성. 4일 연속 매수 판단 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold at 38.5, now holding neutral at 52.9. MACD histogram improved from -1.1709 to 0.2136, signaling a shift from weakness. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed with the 5-day low at $68.72 and 5-day high at $90.62. Maintaining a buy stance for the 4th consecutive session.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($81.69)/SMA200 ($68.05) — maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (66.4%) + current price level at historical midpoint
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.5→52.9) + exiting oversold and holding neutral + confirming upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1709→0.2136) + improving trend + confirming shift from bearish signals
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $86.07) + 33.55% band width level
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support ($86.60) + based on SMA20 and Pivot S1
· Swing resistance ($97.84) + potential to approach 52-week high upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Higher Low) + confirming recovery trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.65x) + indicating subdued conviction in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (early stage of uptrend) + buy entry conditions met
